title: Authentication bypass (setenv) — review required
description: Authentication is bypassed: bSETENVb (setenv). Permit modules, no-auth sudo, and environment-preserving sudo grant access without proof. This lexical rule flags the entry; the reviewer removes it via no SETENV tag.
remediation: Remove or use no SETENV tag.

tests.line: # audit: user ALL=(ALL) SETENV: ALL present
